newsitem.title: LATVIA: ALL BLUE-CHIPS LOSE GROUND AMID SLOW TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ALL BLUE-CHIPS LOSE GROUND AMID SLOW TRADE.

text.p: * Total turnover on Tuesday was a whisker up at 58,000 against 51,000 lats but all blue-chips lost ground amid generally slow trade
* Rietumu index fell 1.82 pct to 183.35.
* Official list's Kaija cannery and Unibanka were the most traded as they had volume of 7,000 and 6,900 lats respectively.
Kaija was three santimes down to 2.35 lats and Unibanka also fell by seven santimes to 3.29 lats.
* Daugavpils Chain led the secondary list with 6,300 lats of shares traded as it slipped five santimes to 2.35 lats.
Latvian blue-chips lost ground amid continued slow trade on Tuesday and the fall was not seen bottomming out as investors wait on the sidelines, dealers said.
Total turnover rose slightly to 58,000 from Monday's 51,000 lats but bourse indices were down.
The Rietumu index fell 1.82 percent to 183.35 and Saules Bank's Saule10 also closed down 1.61 percent to 143.78.
"Prices are falling and will keep doing so as there are no buyers," Robert Idelsons, the head of Trasta Bank's securities department, told Reuters.
"There are no clear signs yet that the fall will bottom out soon," he added.
Official list's Kaija cannery and Unibanka were the most traded as they had volume of 7,000 and 6,900 lats respectively.
Kaija was three santimes down to 2.35 lats and Unibanka also fell by seven santimes to 3.29 lats.
Daugavpils Chain led the secondary list with 6,300 lats of shares traded as it slipped five santimes to 2.35 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet (RTF), Staburadze confectionery and Riga Shipyard on the official list all eased.
RTF registered trade of 7,100 lats and it slipped to 1.19 lats from 1.20 lats and Staburadze saw 3,900 lats of volume.
It lost one santime to fall to 2.69 lats.
The Riga Shipyard fell to 1.33 lats from 1.36 lats on 2,000 lats turnover.
Elsewhere on the secondary list, the Lode Brick was in comparative demand as it saw 6,000 lats worth of its shares change hands and it lost one santime to 2.39 lats.
Salacgriva95 was among the few gainers today, jumping 20 santimes to 4.20 lats on trade of 2,200 lats.
"Salacgriva's rise today is more of a fluctuation on a small volume rather than a sign of the correction reversing itself," Idelsons said.
-- Martinsh Gravitis, Riga Newsroom, +371 721 5240
